lines: The Indiana Fever beat the Seattle Storm 105-95 yesterday and improved to 18-10, first in the Eastern Conference.
The Fever head to Portland on Friday at 10 PM ET for their next game.
Indy Eleven travel to San Antonio on Friday night, 9 PM ET, with a 6-3-6 record.
The Indianapolis Indians edged the Louisville Bats 5-4 yesterday, moving to 49-54.
The Indians return to face Louisville again tonight at 6:35 PM ET.
